description: Grid Topology and Time Series Data: Assessing Future Grid Reinforcement Needs in Rural Morocco: The Role of PV and Storage is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sylvia Wüst, Mohammed Laamim (Offenburg University of Applied Sciences). This dataset contains the research data (grid topology, component parameters, and time-series load/generation data) of the journal article https://doi.org/10.1080/14786451.2026.2618349: Abstract: Rural grids in Morocco face increasing energy demand and infrastructure limitations, necessitating sustainable solutions to ensure reliable electricity supply. Coverage: national (MA); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
